_comment: Hand-curated names and notes for what the game leaves numbered. Never generated; see CLAUDE.md.

666.name: Start
666.note: Every level ends with exactly one of these. It carries the start cell, a second cell it looks at, two angles, and a number that is 99 on 207 of the 230 levels and lower on a dozen of the numbered ones, which reads as the level's time.

/HELL/HELL.PAK#18.note: 160 of its 178 blocks are not part of the level at all. They lie flat on z=32, the ceiling of the lattice and 22 blocks above the playable structure, spelling VERY WELL DONE in block letters six blocks tall.
